articles.title_zh: 特朗普、习近平和普京在宗教自由状况恶化之际会晤
articles.content: U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin met Thursday in Shenzhen, China, for an unprecedented trilateral summit, projecting an image of cooperation among three of the world’s most powerful nations but offering few concrete agreements on the conflicts and international issues facing them. The roughly 80-minute meeting produced a joint statement addressing United Nations reform, energy production, international legal authority, and nuclear risks. However, the statement offered no clear breakthroughs on the wars in Ukraine or Iran and made no public reference to religious freedom or the persecution of religious communities in China and Russia. The gathering underscored the importance of direct engagement among world leaders as they seek to manage competing interests, global conflicts, and questions about the future of international order. The summit also offered an opportunity to address concerns affecting millions of people who face persecution for their faith, particularly in countries governed by authoritarian regimes. A Summit Focused on Global Stability The three leaders presented themselves as sharing responsibility for maintaining international peace and security. Their joint statement called for United Nations reform, increased production and supply of petroleum products, and further dialogue on reducing nuclear risks. The leaders also emphasized state sovereignty and the immunity of government officials, declaring that the International Criminal Court and similar bodies should not abuse their authority. The language reflects a shared interest among the three governments in limiting the reach of international institutions, although their respective political, economic, and security priorities remain distinct. Concerningly, this language is similar to that used by China in pushing back on American calls to respect human rights and ensure citizens can freely practice religion. Claiming that these are internal affairs, China rejects what it considers to be overly zealous policing by the U.S. and continues on its path of persecution. Putin described the summit as a new chapter in diplomatic history and praised the opportunity for direct engagement with Trump and Xi. The Russian president also invoked the 1945 Yalta Conference, which helped shape the postwar European order, arguing that international conflicts eventually require countries to recognize realities on the ground. While the leaders expressed interest in dialogue and international stability, their meeting did not produce publicly announced agreements to resolve major conflicts or address underlying tensions between their governments. Religious Freedom Remains a Global Concern For religious freedom advocates, high-level diplomatic meetings represent an important opportunity to raise the plight of prisoners of conscience and religious communities facing government persecution. China, in particular, continues to impose severe restrictions on religious practice. Christians in unregistered churches face surveillance, detention, church closures, and pressure to submit to government oversight. The Chinese Communist Party’s campaign to bring religious institutions under its control has affected Protestant house churches, Catholic communities, Tibetan Buddhists, Uyghur Muslims, and other religious minorities. In recent months, international advocates have urged the Trump administration to raise the cases of imprisoned religious leaders with Xi. Earlier this year, Trump raised the case of Pastor Ezra Jin Mingri, founder of Beijing’s Zion Church, during a meeting with Xi. Chinese authorities subsequently released Jin, who later relocated to the United States. However, other Zion Church leaders arrested during the same crackdown remain detained, and no such direct advocacy seems to have occurred at this most recent meeting. The case demonstrated how direct presidential engagement can potentially influence the circumstances
articles.content_zh:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普,中国国家主席习近平,俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京星期四在中国深圳举行前所未有的三边峰会,展现出世界三大强国之间合作的形象,但很少就它们面临的冲突和国际问题达成具体协议.

大约80分钟的会议产生了关于联合国改革、能源生产、国际法律权威和核风险的联合声明。 然而,该声明对于乌克兰或伊朗的战争没有提出明确的突破,也没有公开提及中国和俄罗斯的宗教自由或对宗教团体的迫害.

会议强调了世界领导人直接参与的重要性,因为他们寻求管理相互竞争的利益、全球冲突和有关国际秩序未来的问题。 首脑会议还提供了一个机会,解决影响到数百万因信仰而面临迫害的人的关切,特别是在专制政权统治的国家。

以全球稳定为重点的首脑会议 三位领导人自称分担维护国际和平与安全的责任。 他们的联合声明呼吁联合国改革、增加石油产品的生产和供应,以及就减少核风险进一步进行对话。

各国领导人还强调国家主权和政府官员的豁免权,宣布国际刑事法院和类似机构不应滥用其权力。 其措辞反映了三国政府对限制国际机构的影响力的共同利益,尽管它们各自的政治、经济和安全优先事项仍然不同。

关于这一点,这种语言类似于中国在抵制美国尊重人权和确保公民可以自由信奉宗教的呼声时所使用的语言。 中国声称这是内政,反对美国过于狂热地维持治安,继续走迫害的道路。

普京将峰会描述为外交史上的新篇章,并称赞与特朗普和习近平直接接触的机会. 俄罗斯总统还援引了1945年雅尔塔会议,会议帮助塑造了战后的欧洲秩序,认为国际冲突最终需要各国承认当地的实际情况.

虽然领导人对对话和国际稳定表示兴趣,但他们的会议没有达成公开宣布的协议,以解决重大冲突或解决政府之间的紧张关系。

宗教自由仍然是全球关注的问题 对于宗教自由倡导者来说,高级别外交会议是一个重要的机会,可以提高良心犯和宗教界面临政府迫害的困境。 特别是中国继续严格限制宗教活动.

在未登记的教堂的基督徒面临监视,拘留,教堂关闭,以及服从政府监督的压力. 中国共产党将宗教机构置于其控制之下的运动影响了新教住宅教堂,天主教社区,藏传佛教,维吾尔穆斯林等宗教少数派.

最近几个月,国际倡导者敦促特朗普政府向习近平提出被囚禁宗教领袖的案件. 今年早些时候,特朗普在北京锡安教会创始人伊兹拉·金明里牧师会见习近平时提出这个案例. 中国当局随后释放了后来移居美国的金.

然而,在同一次镇压中被捕的其他锡安教会领导人仍然被拘留,在最近的这次会议上似乎没有进行这种直接的宣传。 该案表明,总统直接参与会如何影响局势

articles.title_zh: 在持续冲突的背景下，东盟继续将缅甸军政府排除在外
articles.content: Southeast Asian leaders reaffirmed their opposition to Myanmar’s military government at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) summit in Manila on Nov. 15, extending restrictions on the country’s political representation after concluding that its military leadership had made insufficient progress toward ending the country’s civil war. The decision came as leaders from the 11-member regional bloc gathered in the Philippines for three days of discussions on international conflicts, regional security, and economic stability. Myanmar’s continuing violence and humanitarian crisis featured prominently, alongside disputes in the South China Sea and the broader consequences of conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine. In a statement following their review of Myanmar’s implementation of a five-point peace plan adopted in 2021, ASEAN leaders expressed deep concern over the continuing conflict. They denounced attacks against civilians and public infrastructure. They called on all parties to halt indiscriminate violence, protect civilian populations, and allow humanitarian assistance to reach those in need. The leaders also agreed to maintain the restriction preventing Myanmar’s military leader and foreign minister from attending ASEAN summits and foreign ministers’ meetings until meaningful progress is made toward implementing the peace plan. Myanmar will continue to be represented at those meetings by lower-level diplomatic officials. The decision represents a positive continuation of ASEAN’s effort to pressure Myanmar’s military leadership while preserving diplomatic channels with the country. A Peace Plan with Little Progress Myanmar has been embroiled in a nationwide civil war since February 2021, when the military overthrew the elected government of Aung San Suu Kyi. The coup prompted widespread protests and a violent crackdown by security forces. Armed resistance subsequently emerged across the country, with longstanding ethnic armed organizations also intensifying their campaigns against the military. In April 2021, ASEAN developed a five-point consensus intended to address the crisis. The agreement called for an immediate cessation of violence, constructive dialogue among all parties, mediation by an ASEAN special envoy, humanitarian assistance, and engagement between the envoy and relevant stakeholders. Despite repeated diplomatic efforts, the plan has produced little meaningful progress toward ending the conflict. ASEAN has struggled to balance its traditional policy of noninterference in member states’ domestic affairs with the need to respond to the increasingly severe humanitarian and political crisis in Myanmar. The bloc has maintained contact with the military government while withholding full political recognition at its highest-level meetings. In May 2025, ASEAN attempted to strengthen its approach by making the special envoy position permanent rather than replacing the representative annually. The change was intended to provide greater continuity in diplomatic engagement and improve the prospects for negotiations. However, continued military operations and widespread abuses have undermined those efforts. According to the Assistance Association for Political Prisoners, an independent monitoring organization, more than 8,600 people had been killed and 32,406 arrested by Myanmar’s security forces as of this week. The figures reflect the extensive human cost of the conflict and the government’s continued repression of opposition. Myanmar’s military leadership has also attempted to restore its international standing. Military chief Min Aung Hlaing became president in April following elections conducted in phases in December and January. Opposition groups and international observers criticized the elections as an effort to consolidate military control rather than restore genuine civilian government. articles.content_zh:
东南亚领导人在11月15日于马尼拉举行的东南亚国家联盟(东盟)首脑会议上重申反对缅甸军政府,认为缅甸的军事领导在结束该国内战方面进展不足后,延长了对该国政治代表权的限制.

这项决定是11个成员的区域集团领导人在菲律宾聚集一堂,讨论国际冲突、区域安全和经济稳定问题,为期三天。 缅甸的持续暴力和人道主义危机与南中国海的争端以及中东和乌克兰冲突的更广泛后果一道,占据了显著地位。

东盟领导人在审查缅甸执行2021年通过的五点和平计划后发表声明,对持续冲突深表关切. 他们谴责对平民和公共基础设施的袭击。 他们呼吁所有各方停止不分青红皂白的暴力,保护平民,允许人道主义援助送达需要援助的人。

领导人还同意继续限制缅甸的军事领导人和外交部长出席东盟首脑会议和外交部长会议,直到在执行和平计划方面取得有意义的进展。 缅甸将继续派低级外交官员出席这些会议。

这一决定是东盟在保持与缅甸的外交渠道的同时向缅甸军事领导人施压的努力的积极继续。 自2021年2月军方推翻昂山素季当选政府以来,与小进步缅甸的和平计划卷入全国内战.

政变引发了广泛的抗议和安全部队的暴力镇压. 武装抵抗随后在全国各地出现,长期存在的族裔武装组织也加强了对军队的进攻。 2021年4月,东盟达成了旨在应对危机的五点共识.

协定要求立即停止暴力,所有各方进行建设性对话,由东盟特使进行调解,提供人道主义援助,特使与相关利益攸关方进行接触。 尽管一再作出外交努力,但该计划在结束冲突方面没有取得什么有意义的进展。

东盟努力在不干涉成员国内政的传统政策与应对缅甸日益严重的人道主义和政治危机的必要性之间取得平衡。 该集团与军政府保持联系,同时拒绝在最高级别会议上给予充分的政治承认。

2025年5月,东盟试图加强其做法,使特使的职位永久化,而不是每年更换代表。 这一变化旨在增加外交接触的连续性,改善谈判前景。 然而,持续的军事行动和普遍的侵权行为破坏了这些努力。

据独立监督组织政治犯援助协会称,截至本周,缅甸安全部队已杀害8 600多人,逮捕32 406人。 这些数字反映了冲突给人带来的巨大代价以及政府继续镇压反对派。

缅甸的军事领导人也试图恢复其国际地位。 在12月和1月分阶段举行选举之后,军事长官敏昂·赫莱于4月成为总统。 反对派团体和国际观察员批评选举是为了巩固军事控制而不是恢复真正的文职政府。

尽管访问了东盟的几个成员国,敏昂莱仍然被排除在集团最高领导层之外。

articles.title: Caso cuoteos se complica con chats , denuncias penales y cuestionamientos cruzados
articles.summary: La controversia salió a la luz el 16 de noviembre, cuando se difundió un audio atribuido a la diputada Claudia Bilbao, en el que reclama a Quiroga por no haber contratado a personas que habría recomen
articles.content: La controversia salió a la luz el 16 de noviembre, cuando se difundió un audio atribuido a la diputada Claudia Bilbao, en el que reclama a Quiroga por no haber contratado a personas que habría recomendado. El caso de presunto cuoteo político en la Agencia de Infraestructura en Salud y Equipamiento Médico (AISEM) se amplió con denuncias penales, audios y conversaciones de WhatsApp difundidos públicamente, además de acusaciones cruzadas entre diputados oficialistas del Partido Demócrata Cristiano (PDC) y la exdirectora de la entidad, Daniela Quiroga. Las presuntas presiones y el inicio del caso La controversia salió a la luz el 16 de noviembre, cuando se difundió un audio atribuido a la diputada Claudia Bilbao, en el que reclama a Quiroga por no haber contratado a personas que habría recomendado. La legisladora reconoció la conversación, pero sostuvo que la grabación estaba recortada y negó haber enviado listas de postulantes. El 17 de noviembre se conoció una segunda grabación, esta vez atribuida al diputado Alejandro Medinaceli. En ella cuestiona que dos designaciones no se hubieran concretado como, según señala, habían instruido. «¿Daniela, quieres seguir trabajando o no? No entiendo. Porque nos estás generando problemas», se escucha decir al legislador. Quiroga explicó posteriormente que las presuntas presiones comenzaron con recomendaciones de hojas de vida, pero se intensificaron durante los últimos tres o cuatro meses de los siete que permaneció al frente de la institución. Según su testimonio, las solicitudes se transformaron en amenazas cuando se negaba a contratar a personas que no cumplían los perfiles profesionales. Quiroga identifica un “clan” En entrevista con ERBOL, la exdirectora identificó a Claudia Bilbao, Alejandro Medinaceli y Óscar García como integrantes de un supuesto grupo que actuaba coordinadamente para gestionar contrataciones. «Los tres definían, por así decirlo, a quién me enviaban (…) Era como un clan», afirmó. Quiroga aseguró que recibió aproximadamente 50 currículums remitidos por legisladores y estimó que alrededor de 40 personas llegaron a incorporarse a la AISEM. En otra entrevista, ante ANF, habló de al menos 100 hojas de vida y aclaró que algunas contrataciones se concretaron cuando los postulantes cumplían los requisitos establecidos. Atribuyó a Bilbao el envío de la mayor cantidad de currículums, aproximadamente 30, mediante mensajes de WhatsApp y documentos físicos. También señaló que la diputada indicaba los cargos que debían ocupar los postulantes. Como ejemplo, mencionó el caso de una persona propuesta para una jefatura de auditoría que no había concluido la carrera universitaria. Sobre Medinaceli, afirmó que le reclamaba por las personas que no eran incorporadas y que incluso la convocaba a reuniones en su oficina del piso 19 de la Casa Grande del Pueblo. También mencionó a Alejandro Aparicio como un intermediario que inicialmente llevaba las hojas de vida de los legisladores. La exdirectora relató que las negativas a determinadas contrataciones derivaron en amenazas. «Ya había un hostigamiento: si no pones, te vas. O sea, tienes que ponerlo porque si no te vamos a sacar», manifestó. También lamentó no haber denunciado antes las situaciones que, según dijo, llegó a normalizar durante su gestión. Las respuestas de los diputados Bilbao reconoció que conversó con Quiroga, pero sostuvo que la grabación difundida omitió partes en las que, según su versión, reclamaba por la permanencia de funcionarios del Movimiento Al Socialismo (MAS). También negó haber enviado listas de nombres y justificó sus reclamos con denuncias que habría recibido sobre presuntos cobros de hasta el 50% de los salarios de algunos funcionarios, por lo que calificó la difusión del audio como una «venganza». Medinaceli, por su parte, admitió que la voz de la grabación corresponde a una conversación suya con Quiroga, pero afirmó que el audio fue editado y no contiene todo el diálogo. articles.summary_zh: 费丝·库克（ Faith Cook ）的《麻烦之旅》（ Troubled Journey ）讲述了她作为OMF中国传教士的女儿的早期经历。为了表彰父母的信仰、勇气和自我牺牲，她还富有同情心地揭示了与父母长期分离所带来的家庭剥夺。下面的摘录是该书的第11章，其中[…]邮政父母：传教士儿童的经历首先出现在美国真理旗帜上。
articles.title_zh: 邮政父母：传教士儿童的经历
articles.content: Faith Cook’s Troubled Journey narrates her early experiences as the daughter of OMF missionaries to China. Honouring the faith, courage, and self-sacrifice of her parents, she also shines a compassionate light on the family deprivations brought about by long periods of separation from them. The excerpt below is Chapter 11 of the book in question, which cover Faith’s childhood between the ages of fourteen and eighteen. A passage on the P & O Carthage was booked for Stanley and Norah [Faith’s parents—Ed.] in early January 1952, only eight months after our family had first arrived back from China. It was a subdued Christmas we spent together that year, the last for some years to come. Frantic packing followed, purchasing school uniform and preparing for the long outward journey back to the Far East, this time by sea. A round of speaking engagements filled the days for my parents and seemingly eased the ache of the forthcoming separation. As the day of parting drew ever nearer, I noticed a new tenderness in their attitude towards me – a tenderness that only added to my distress. And at last came the day of departure. It would be four years before we would see them again. Photographs were taken on the steps of the mission headquarters, as all joined to wish the departing missionaries well. Norah’s expression told a story, as did fifteen-year-old Christopher’s forced smile, for in reality, the boy’s spirit was at breaking point. On we went to the station where our parents would board a train to Southampton. A large contingent of missionary personnel followed, for this departure was highly significant for the entire future of the mission, urgently seeking a new role for its operations now the door to China was closed. I found myself thrust to the back of the crowd as the train slowly moved off. Suddenly one more thoughtful friend spotted the irony of the situation and pushed me to the front to catch the last glimpse of my parents as they stood waving at the window of the train, my mother looking tense and tearful, and my father strained. Back at the mission home once more, we were at a loose end. No guardian had yet been appointed to care for us, although one or two kindly adults helped out if I asked for assistance. The Spring term would soon begin and I was glad. Some of my new clothes were too long and needed altering, and I discovered with alarm that the shoe repairer considered my school shoes beyond his skills to patch up. Never handy with a needle, I tried my best to turn up the hems myself. At last the third week of January arrived and I was on the train back to my well-loved school – a place I now regarded as home. Although soon immersed once more in all the trivia of boarding school life, I found time each week to write a letter to my parents. The first few letters were addressed to ports en route for Malaysia where the P & O Carthage would call: Aden, Penang and then to Singapore to await their arrival. Stanley and Norah treasured these schoolgirl epistles, storing them all up, until at last my father would present his married daughter with a shoe box crammed with letters dating from January 1952 until the time that he and my mother finally retired from missionary service in Malaysia more than twenty years later. These letters form a unique commentary on the development of a postal relationship with my parents that would form the bedrock of my security and development from a young teenager to womanhood and beyond. Faithfully my parents replied to each letter, commenting on my progress, chiding when they could sense my behaviour was becoming erratic, and offering advice as well as they were able. Not long after arriving back at the mission headquarters in London at the end of the spring school term, I discovered that a middle-aged couple had been appointed as guardians for the children of the missionaries: Louis and Nancy Gaussen. Understanding and kindly, they were well-suited to care for the children. ‘Mr and Mrs Gaussen
articles.content_zh: Faith Cook的"麻烦之旅"讲述了她作为OMF传教士去中国的女儿的早期经历. 她以对父母的信仰、勇气和自我牺牲的敬意,也为长期与父母分离所带来的家庭贫困而发出同情之光。 下面的节录是该书第11章,其中涵盖了费斯14至18岁的童年. 1952年1月初,我们一家刚从中国回来才八个月,为斯坦利和诺拉(Faith的父母——Ed.)预订了P & O迦太基号上的一段。 那年是我们一起度过的圣诞 几年来的最后一天 紧随其后的弗朗克包装,购买了校服并准备了远东的漫长出行旅程,这次是海上出行. 一轮的演讲为我父母提供了时间,似乎缓解了即将到来的分居的痛苦。 随着离别日的临近,我注意到他们对我的态度出现了新的温柔,这种温柔只会使我更加痛苦。 终于到了出发之日 四年后我们才能再见到他们 对特派团总部的步骤进行了拍照,因为所有人都希望离开的传教士们一切顺利。 Norah的言论讲述了一个故事,15岁的Christopher被迫微笑也讲述了一个故事,因为实际上,这名男孩的精神正在崩溃。 我们去了车站 在那里,我们的父母 会登上火车到南安普顿。 随即派出了大批传教人员,因为这次出走对传教团的整个未来都具有重大意义,因此紧急寻求为传教团的行动起新的作用,现在中国的大门已经关闭了。 我发现自己被推倒 在人群的后部 当火车慢慢地离开。 突然又有一位深思熟虑的朋友发现情况具有讽刺意味,把我推到前面,以抓住我父母站在火车窗前挥手的最后一眼,我母亲看起来紧张而泪流满面,而我父亲也感到紧张. 回到了任务之家, 我们处在一个松散的结局。 目前还没有指定监护人来照顾我们,不过,如果我想得到帮助,一两个成年人会帮助我们。 春季学期即将开始 我很高兴 一些我的新衣服太长,需要更换,我惊恐地发现,修鞋者认为我的校鞋超出了他的能力来补补补. 我从不用针指手画脚,我尽力自己把螺丝弄大 终于在一月的第三个星期抵达, 我坐上火车回到我深爱的学校, 虽然我很快再次沉浸在寄宿学校生活的三难之中,但我发现每周都有时间写信给我的父母。 最初的几封信是寄给前往马来西亚的港口,P&O迦太基会称这些港口为:亚丁,槟城,再到新加坡等他们到达. 斯坦利和诺拉珍藏了这些女学生的表皮, 把它们全部储存起来, 直到最后我父亲会向他的已婚女儿展示一个鞋盒, 里面塞有1952年1月的信件, 直到他和我妈妈20多年后终于从马来西亚的传教士退休。 这些信件构成了关于与我父母发展邮政关系的独特评论,这将构成我从青少年到妇女时代及以后的安全和发展的基石。 诚然,我的父母每一封信都回信,评论我的进展,当他们能感觉到我的行为变得不规则时,他们就会发号施令,并尽可能地提供建议。 在春季学期结束回到伦敦的使团总部不久后,我发现一对中年夫妇被指定为传教士子女监护人:路易和南希·高森. 理解和友善,他们很适合照顾孩子。 高森夫妇

articles.content: L’événement a marqué son temps. Le 28 octobre 1926, Pie XI sacrait évêques six prêtres chinois dans la basilique Saint-Pierre. Des prêtres spécialement venus à Rome pour leur ordination afin de marquer leurs liens et leur fidélité au siège pétrinien. Ces sacres marquaient alors une véritable volonté missionnaire et l’espoir d’un christianisme d’expansion en Chine. Dès Léon XIII, l’Église eut la volonté de former un clergé local, autochtone, pour favoriser la vivacité des Églises particulières et ne pas donner l’impression que la christianisation était le bras armé de la colonisation. En novembre 1919, Benoît XV publia un premier texte d’envergure avec la lettre apostolique Maximum illud. Le prêtre autochtone y est présenté comme « merveilleusement adapté à instiller la foi » dans le cœur de ses compatriotes. Pour le Pape « on ne doit pas former un clergé indigène de classe inférieure » : la formation du clergé autochrome doit être solide et identique à celle du clergé européen. articles.content_zh:
该活动标志着它的时间。 1926年10月28日，庇护十一世在圣彼得大教堂祝圣了六名中国神父为主教。神父们特意来到罗马接受任命，以表明他们与彼得大帝教区的联系和忠诚。这些加冕礼标志着真正的传教愿望和基督教在中国扩张的希望。

从利奥十三世开始，教会就希望培养当地的土著神职人员，以促进特定教会的活力，而不是给人留下基督教化是殖民化武装派系的印象。 1919 年 11 月，本笃十五世发表了第一部主要文本以及使徒书信《Maximum illud》。

这位当地牧师被描述为“非常适合在同胞心中灌输信仰”。对于教皇来说，“我们不能训练低层的本土神职人员”：对自体铬神职人员的培训必须是扎实的，并且与欧洲神职人员的培训相同。

articles.title: Batalha do Salado ( figuraes na historiografia medieval )
articles.summary: A celebração dos novecentos anos de Portugal convoca uma reflexão sobre os momentos inaugurais em que o registo histórico se funde não só com o imaginário lendário, como com o cruzamento de presciênci
articles.content: A celebração dos novecentos anos de Portugal convoca uma reflexão sobre os momentos inaugurais em que o registo histórico se funde não só com o imaginário lendário, como com o cruzamento de presciências tornando-se alicerce da identidade coletiva também através de matrizes simbólicas. Este cruzamento corrobora dimensões factuais essenciais para a compreensão do percurso civilizacional, evidenciando, segundo Mircea Eliade (1907-1986), que a dimensão racional do logos não extingue relatos míticos e emocionais, antes os absorve e valida enquanto testemunhos antropológicos. A Batalha do Salado Travada a 30 de outubro de 1340, junto ao Rio Salado, nas proximidades de Tarifa, Espanha, constitui um dos marcos mais decisivos da geopolítica ibérica do século XIV. O confronto colocou lado a lado os reinos cristãos de Castela e Portugal (com apoio de Aragão) contra as forças muçulmanas do Sultanato Merínida de Marrocos e do Emirado de Granada, traduzindo-se no confronto direto entre a coligação cristã, liderada por Afonso XI de Castela e D. Afonso IV de Portugal, e a contraofensiva islâmica encabeçada pelo referido Sultanato Merínida de Abu al-Hassan, em aliança com o Reino Nacérida de Granada. Do ponto de vista estritamente militar, a intervenção do contingente português revelou-se um elemento de crucial importância estratégica. A coordenação tática entre as forças peninsulares permitiu neutralizar a superioridade numérica adversária e estancar a última grande tentativa de expansão magrebina no ocidente europeu, fixando de forma definitiva o controlo cristão sobre as margens do Estreito de Gibraltar. Dimensões Em termos historiográficos e simbólicos, o desfecho da Batalha transcendeu a imediata vitória territorial, assumindo uma profunda dimensão de legitimação política e dinástica para a Coroa de Portugal. Numa época marcada por tensões intermonárquicas latentes, a solidariedade militar prestada por D. Afonso IV consolidou a soberania portuguesa face ao expansionismo castelhano, ao mesmo tempo que elevou o prestígio internacional do monarca, doravante cognominado “o Bravo”. Adicionalmente, o conflito foi instrumentalizado através duma retórica de cruzada fortemente enraizada na mentalidade medieval. A cronística coeva e a tratadística posterior sacralizaram o acontecimento, convertendo-o num pilar da identidade nacional fundado na defesa da Cristandade, o que conferiu à dinastia de Borgonha uma renovada autoridade moral e um papel central no xadrez diplomático europeu. Cronística medieval A cronística medieval portuguesa – cronicões, crónicas e nobiliários – enquanto género literário-historiográfico, não atua apenas como um mero registo de factos, mas como um poderoso instrumento de legitimação política e de construção da memória dinástica. No século XIV, a escrita da História servia de palco à afirmação da soberania de Portugal no complexo tabuleiro geopolítico peninsular. O tratamento textual da Batalha do Salado nas letras revela uma intencionalidade clara: monumentalizar a intervenção de D. Afonso IV e fixar um modelo de realeza fundado na valentia militar e na piedade cristã. Destarte, abandona a frieza do relato factual para adotar uma retórica de teor épico, contrariando a natural tendência da cronística castelhana em menorizar o papel dos contingentes lusos. D. Afonso IV presentifica-se sob o prisma da necessitas – o rei não age por ambição territorial, mas sim para acudir à Cristandade e responder ao apelo de auxílio do seu genro, Afonso XI de Castela. Tal construção projeta no imaginário a imagem de um Portugal autónomo, cuja força militar é indispensável para a sobrevivência dos restantes reinos hispânicos. articles.title: Adiós Leon XIV : la miniserie de 4 caps sobre los misterios de la fe que conquista Netflix
articles.summary: (BUENOS AIRES).- Netflix tiene disponible Misterios de la fe, una miniserie documental de cuatro episodios sobre algunas de las reliquias más sagradas del cristianismo. La producción recorre las histo
articles.content: (BUENOS AIRES).- Netflix tiene disponible Misterios de la fe, una miniserie documental de cuatro episodios sobre algunas de las reliquias más sagradas del cristianismo. La producción recorre las historias, creencias y controversias que rodean a esos objetos. Las piezas que aparecen en la serie estuvieron vinculadas con Jesús y con momentos importantes de la historia cristiana, según la tradición religiosa. El recorrido muestra cómo atravesaron los siglos y se convirtieron en símbolos de devoción para millones de creyentes. Para reconstruir esas historias, la miniserie combina investigaciones, testimonios y reconstrucciones. Uno de los episodios aborda la Corona de Espinas, que, según la tradición, fue colocada sobre la cabeza de Jesús durante la crucifixión. El documental también recuerda el incendio de la catedral de Notre Dame, en París, ocurrido en 2019. En ese contexto, repasa el operativo que permitió rescatar la reliquia de las llamas. El Santo Grial, la copa asociada con la Última Cena, aparece entre los grandes interrogantes de la producción. La serie explora distintas teorías sobre su posible paradero y presenta las versiones que rodean a esa reliquia. El objeto forma parte de un recorrido que combina la historia con las creencias vinculadas a los símbolos cristianos. La miniserie también se detiene en el Velo de Manoppello, una tela conservada en Italia. Algunos fieles le atribuyen una representación del rostro de Cristo. La producción incorpora esa creencia a su recorrido por objetos venerados y por las historias que se formaron alrededor de ellos. Otro tramo sigue la Vera Cruz, vinculada con la crucifixión de Jesús, y llega hasta Río de Janeiro, donde se conserva un fragmento de la reliquia. Las historias presentadas abren preguntas sobre la autenticidad de esos objetos y el lugar que ocupan dentro de la fe. La propuesta combina historia, investigación y espiritualidad para abordar esas cuestiones. La llegada del papa León XIV a Argentina el 8 de noviembre de 2026 volvió a poner a la Iglesia Católica y sus tradiciones en el centro de la atención. El pontífice tenía una agenda de encuentros y celebraciones hasta el miércoles 11. En ese marco, la miniserie aparece como una propuesta para quienes buscan profundizar en los símbolos y las historias del cristianismo, incluso fuera de las comunidades religiosas.
